1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.a3 d6 5.h3.strategy: A second waiting move, this time taking g4 from Black's bishop so that a pin on the f3 knight never comes. White keeps a flexible, solid set-up, but two prophylactic moves in a row leave Black free to develop as it likes.
1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.a3 d6 5.h3.name: Four Knights Game: Gunsberg Variation, Provincial Opening
